_comment: Business policy for the CCE platform. Every section is optional and merged over the defaults in src/cce_platform/business_data/policy.py, so this file only needs the values you want to override. Product keys are uppercased on load. Override the path with CCE_POLICY_PATH; mount as a ConfigMap in Kubernetes. Call policy.reload_policy() to pick up edits without a restart.
_comment_compliance: SGD amount at or above which a transaction routes through COMPLIANCE_HOLD. A product omitted here is never held on amount alone. Set by regulation.
_comment_priority: Cart display weight; higher sorts first. Owned by whoever runs the campaign.
_comment_quote: How long a quote stays valid, in minutes. 0 = never expires.
_comment_settlement: Business days between trade date and settlement. Set by the market.
